x.d: Pointe shoe Salvatore Capezio designed in honour of Anna Pavlova, who bought Capezio shoes on her US tour.
Hand-made pointe shoes from the Sydney workshop Jacob Bloch began in 1932.
Moscow-made pointe shoe on Grishko's 2007 last, one of the brand's four main lasts.
Pointe shoe with an injection-moulded elastomer shank and box in graded stiffnesses.

kinds.d: Soft, flexible slipper made for ballet practice and performance.
Dance shoe with metal plates at toe and heel that sound the steps.
Soft split-sole slip-on or lace-up shoe made for jazz dance.

brands.d: Ballet and theatrical shoemaker founded by Frederick and Dora Freed on St Martin's Lane; factory in Hackney.
Dance shoe and apparel maker begun by cobbler Salvatore Capezio near the old Metropolitan Opera House, New York.
Dance shoe and dancewear maker begun by Jacob Bloch in Paddington, Sydney.
Moscow pointe-shoe maker founded by Nikolay Grishko, now also making dancewear.
New York pointe-shoe maker of John and Eliza Gaynor Minden using elastomer shanks and boxes; shoes made in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Paris dance-shoe house founded by Rose Repetto; maker of the Cendrillon ballet flat.

traditions.d: Hand-making of turn-shoe pointe shoes with paste-hardened blocks, each maker identified by a personal mark.
traditions.tech: turn-shoe construction sewn inside out, block built from layers of paper, card and hessian with flour paste, baked overnight
traditions.mat: satin, paper, card, hessian, flour paste, leather sole
ctr: Freed of London, St Martin's Lane shop and Hackney factory
traditions.auth: maker's symbol stamped on the sole (e.g. Crown, Wine Glass, Fish); no wood in the block

notes: All six old kinds kept. Pointe shoe: archetypes Freed, Capezio Pavlova, Bloch (old Bloch models as versions), Grishko 2007 (old 2007 Pro plus lasts), Gaynor Minden (old models); Repetto and Merlet models in m. Tap, jazz, character and ballet shoes as tier lists from retrieved guides. Not added: Bloch Heritage and Jetstream, Russian Pointe, Suffolk, Sansha, So Danca models (no retrieved page naming them; So Danca only as a brand mention). Merlet brand entry omitted.
